headline: Lock Of George Washington Hair Sells At Auction For Four Thousand
seoTitle: Lock of George Washington Hair Sold at Auction
metaDescription: A rare lock of George Washington's hair has been sold at a recent auction for four thousand dollars after being passed down through a private family.
aiSummaryBullets: A lock of hair belonging to the first U.S. president sold at auction for 4,000 dollars.
The artifact was held by John Gadsby before Washington died in 1799.
The item was sold by Richmond Auctions, a firm based in South Carolina.
aiContextParagraph: A historical artifact consisting of a lock of hair belonging to former U.S. President George Washington was recently sold during an auction for 4,000 dollars. According to reports from the auction house Richmond Auctions, the item has a documented history originating from John Gadsby, who reportedly shared a meal with Washington shortly before the former president passed away in 1799. The lock of hair was passed down through the generations by Gadsby's family, who reportedly cherished the artifact alongside a portrait of the first president. While items connected to the founding of the United States often attract interest from collectors, this specific sale highlights the ongoing market for personal effects once owned by significant historical figures. The auction in South Carolina marks another instance where personal items of Washington have reached high prices among collectors of American presidential memorabilia.
whyItIsViral: The story reached three independent outlets with steady coverage, reflecting interest in historical presidential artifacts.
